title: Global Edge CDN & Distributed Video Transcoding Mesh
subtitle: Serverless edge chunking, Temporal distributed workflow orchestration, GPU AV1/H.265 transcoding, and multi-CDN adaptive bitrate delivery.

overview.summary: A high-throughput distributed media processing architecture capable of ingesting 4K raw video streams, slicing them into parallel chunks across thousands of ephemeral GPU workers, and serving adaptive bitrate HLS/DASH streams globally.
overview.problemStatement: Transcoding 4K/8K 60fps media in monolithic pipelines results in hours of processing latency, unpredictable worker crashes, and massive cloud egress charges.
corePrinciples: Edge chunking splitting raw videos into 5-second GOP segments for mass parallel transcoding
Temporal workflow state machine managing retries, fallback encoders, and pipeline orchestration
Tiered multi-CDN routing optimizing for cost and lowest buffering ratio
Zero-egress object storage utilizing Cloudflare R2 and AWS S3

data.label: Creator Upload App
data.subtitle: Direct Multipart Presigned Uploader
data.description: Browser / Mobile application using TUS protocol and presigned S3/R2 multi-part upload URLs for accelerated direct upload.

data.label: Raw Ingestion Bucket
data.subtitle: Cloudflare R2 / S3 Ingest
data.description: High-throughput object storage emitting lifecycle events into message queues upon multi-part upload completion.

data.label: Temporal Orchestrator
data.subtitle: Distributed Workflow Engine
data.description: Durable execution engine coordinating video chunk splitting, GPU encoder dispatch, quality verification, and HLS manifest packaging.

data.label: GPU Transcoder Fleet
data.subtitle: Rust + FFmpeg + NVENC (Spot)
data.description: Thousands of auto-scaling spot GPU workers encoding video segments into AV1, HEVC, and VP9 adaptive bitrate renditions.

data.label: HLS / DASH Packager
data.subtitle: Shaka Packager & DRM Service
data.description: Stitches encoded chunks, injects FairPlay/Widevine DRM encryption keys, and generates multi-resolution .m3u8 / .mpd playlist manifests.

data.label: Global Multi-CDN Mesh
data.subtitle: Fastly & CloudFront Edge
data.description: Global distributed CDN edge caching video segments (TS / fMP4) with Origin Shield and pre-fetching algorithms.
Parallel chunk upload directly bypassing API servers.
Storage event initiates Temporal transcoding workflow.
Fan-out to hundreds of spot GPU transcode workers.
Aggregates multi-bitrate chunks for playlist composition.
Publishes manifests to origin shield for worldwide streaming.

simulationFlow.title: Creator Uploads Raw 4K Video via Presigned URLs
simulationFlow.description: Client initiates a 5GB 4K 60fps upload. The file is split into 10MB chunks and pushed directly to Cloudflare R2 object storage.

simulationFlow.title: Ingest Event Triggers Temporal Transcode Workflow
simulationFlow.description: Object creation webhook triggers the master Temporal DAG workflow to inspect video metadata and prepare parallel chunk matrix.

simulationFlow.title: Fan-Out to 120 Spot GPU Transcoder Workers
simulationFlow.description: Temporal splits 600-second video into 120 individual 5-second GOP chunks and assigns them across spot GPU instances running FFmpeg NVENC.

simulationFlow.title: Manifest Stitching & DRM Encryption Packaging
simulationFlow.description: Shaka Packager receives all encoded renditions, applies Widevine & FairPlay encryption, and writes final adaptive bitrate HLS manifests.

simulationFlow.title: Global Edge CDN Warms Video Segments
simulationFlow.description: HLS master playlist is pushed to Fastly and CloudFront edge nodes ready for millions of viewers with sub-400ms first frame playback.

tradeoffs.decision: Spot GPU Instances with Temporal vs Dedicated Transcode Clusters
tradeoffs.chosenApproach: Ephemeral Spot GPUs Managed by Temporal Workflow Replays
pros: Cuts cloud GPU compute bills by 72%
Temporal guarantees zero lost work on spot instance termination
Scales dynamically from 0 to 4,000 instances during peak live events
cons: Spot reclamation causes occasional chunk retry latency
